frozen_params.f_convention: f = disclosed bits / (H * N); 64-bit Toeplitz tag EXCLUDED from f (convention carried from predecessors for comparability); A3 tag-inclusive leakage also reported via key_dependent_bits
frozen_params.single_factor: LOW-TOTAL RATIO SEARCH: bounded 8-point grid over two totals (448, 336) x four k1 shares each (ratios ~1:13..1:2.5, including the 1:6 anchor); totals [448, 448, 448, 448, 336, 336, 336, 336] with k1 [32, 64, 96, 128, 24, 48, 72, 96]; d2 = worst_k(H2,k2) per point; d1 = worst_k(H1,k1) recomputed per point from the same frozen family rule
frozen_params.a2_split_rule: not_run (no A2 design/measurement in this probe; A2 summaries not_run)
frozen_params.a3_split_rule: FROZEN bounded low-total ratio grid: 8 points over totals 448 and 336 with k1 shares [32, 64, 96, 128, 24, 48, 72, 96], disclosed 2240 or 1680 bits per point; (f_book bookkeeping only, NOT efficiency points; tag excluded); d1=worst_k(H1,k1) per point; d2=worst_k(H2,k2) per point; same H1/H2 design vectors as C1 (design_seed=2026092600, DESIGN_MC=128)
frozen_params.pairing: per (seed, block): rng=default_rng([seed, block]); draw x=integers(0,1024,N) then delta=choice(1024,N,p=pmf); y=(x+delta)%1024; identical (x,y) reused across the k1 grid via the same (seed,block) index
frozen_params.a3_semantics: run_two_layer_block operational arm FER = (label_match == False); outcomes exact/verify_failed/decode_failed/undetected/resource_abort counted isolated, undetected never merged into success; oracle arm + candidate divergence report-only; toeplitz_master=2026091361

budget.check: every block and every 32 design samples; breach -> immediate stop, status incomplete, no tuning

frozen_params.rerun_policy: one-shot reruns=0: execution-error rerun NOT allowed; any error -> status execution_error/incomplete with traceback, no retry, no parameter/seed change
deviations_from_plan_A_rows: N=1024 (plan A2/A3 row: N=2^15) - packet-frozen Tier-X scale-up, same as predecessor
256 blocks total (8 bounded low-total ratio points x 2 seeds x 16; plan completion: >=1000 blocks) - Tier-X downscale one-shot

k1 grid [32, 64, 96, 128, 24, 48, 72, 96] with disclosed 2240 or 1680 bits depending on total; every point is a bookkeeping-only dose diagnostic and NOT an efficiency point; no point may be described as a usable operating point
channel is parametric F4@q1024 (plan: measured-ternary synthetic) - predecessor froze F4
A3 runs the two-layer GF32 path of the current M2 code (raw GF1024 SC infeasible at q=1024)
64-bit Toeplitz tag excluded from f (convention carried from predecessors for comparability); tag still executed inside A3
A2 not run (no A2 design/measurement; A2 summaries not_run) - predecessor froze cost saving
